band_sum_cells.label: random
band_sum_cells.name: 3-5__band_sum_random
band_sum_cells.rationale: no internal reflection, Haar-uniform poses, linear lens: the sun pixel (singular), a pixel inside the 22 deg halo (empty band) and the halo's inner edge and tail

band_sum_cells.label: plate
band_sum_cells.name: 3-5__band_sum_plate
band_sum_cells.rationale: a narrow zenith family (plate, 1 deg) on a Lambert view: the parhelion of the single path 3-5 (one side only), its tails down to 1e-88, the mirror side where every band event has rho = 0 (K_rho_pos = 0 < K), an empty band inside the halo, and the sun pixel

band_sum_cells.label: parry
band_sum_cells.name: 3-5__band_sum_parry
band_sum_cells.rationale: the roll-locked family (Parry, zenith and roll 1 deg): the density reads all three body-axis zenith components (the roll atan2(-e2, e1)); the upper Parry arc, tails to 1e-238 and a dark pixel

band_sum_cells.label: random
band_sum_cells.name: 3-5-6-7__band_sum_random
band_sum_cells.rationale: two internal reflections weighted by Fresnel R on a Lambert view about the antisun: the antisolar pixel (delta = pi, singular), the lit ring and a dark pixel beyond the path's largest deviation

band_sum_cells.label: random
band_sum_cells.name: 13-15-26-28__band_sum_random
band_sum_cells.rationale: pyramid faces off the prism family on the asymmetric pyramid (the matrix's crystal): the lit ring (D 121-149 deg), a pixel on each side of it and the antisolar pixel

band_sum_cells.label: rank0
band_sum_cells.name: 3-6__band_sum_rank0
band_sum_cells.rationale: a rank-0 path (3-6, parallel faces): a point mass m on the pixel containing the sun, 0 elsewhere; under the random density m is the lattice mean of w, deterministic

band_sum_cells.label: rank0_plate
band_sum_cells.name: 3-6__band_sum_rank0_plate
band_sum_cells.rationale: the same point mass under the plate family: m from LI's Haar stream, compared statistically

band_sum_cells.label: plate
band_sum_cells.name: 3-6-4-8__band_sum_plate
band_sum_cells.rationale: family pinned, reflection group element 6 (fold matrix R_z(120 deg)): the 120 deg parhelion at D = 113.548 deg, its spot centre, the four neighbours, the vertical and horizontal tails down to 1e-26

band_sum_cells.label: plate_sigma_0.5
band_sum_cells.name: 3-6-4-8__band_sum_plate_sigma_0.5
band_sum_cells.rationale: the same view and pixels at half the zenith spread: the centre brightens, the tails fall to 1e-92 (the spot's width scales with sigma; the 3-5 parhelion's does not)

band_sum_cells.label: plate
band_sum_cells.name: 1-2-1__band_sum_plate
band_sum_cells.rationale: family pinned, element 11 (a basal reflection) on a thin plate: the subsun at D = 30 deg, lit along the vertical, falling to 1e-15 across it (the column crystal has no valid pose on this family)

band_sum_cells.label: plate
band_sum_cells.name: 1-2-3-4-1__band_sum_plate
band_sum_cells.rationale: family pinned, element 5 on a thin plate: the 120 deg subparhelion at D = 122.242 deg, a pixel on the path's smallest deviation (120 deg) and an empty band beyond it

cells.name: 3-5__critical
cells.rationale: no internal reflection: the 22 deg halo path on the canonical column (tests/test_discovery.py's production scene); next to an interior extremum of D_P (a caustic): a short loop around a Jacobian-degenerate point

selection.method: lit side of an interior extremum of D_P

cells.name: 3-5__near_boundary
cells.rationale: no internal reflection: the 22 deg halo path on the canonical column (tests/test_discovery.py's production scene); a pose 1e-3 inside the nearest validity gate (Snell/incidence), plus its mirror image outside

selection.method: bisected to a validity margin from the random cell's start

edge_cells.label: short_loop
edge_cells.name: 3-5__short_loop
edge_cells.rationale: a 0.165 rad loop 0.01 deg above the 3-5 minimum deviation, about four initial steps long: the step-aware closure must close it on its first traversal (a loop below the 2 x initial_step closure extent is traversed twice by design, contract section 6.4), and J_perp is smallest here (caustic)

selection.method: lit side of an interior extremum of D_P

edge_cells.label: strip_short_loop_r100_c126
edge_cells.name: 3-5__strip_short_loop_r100_c126
edge_cells.rationale: ch06 strip pixel (100, 126): a 1.645 rad loop shorter than pi that the retired absolute closure gate traversed twice (test_strip_short_loops_close_at_their_single_traversal_length)

selection.method: the component seeds of seed search at the given target

edge_cells.label: caustic_loop_r49_c0
edge_cells.name: 3-5__caustic_loop_r49_c0
edge_cells.rationale: ch06 strip pixel (49, 0): a 0.19 rad loop at the caustic edge whose extra seeds used to end on a spurious event (test_caustic_edge_pixels_are_single_short_closed_loops)

selection.method: the component seeds of seed search at the given target

edge_cells.label: boundary_hugging_r700_c150
edge_cells.name: 3-5__boundary_hugging_r700_c150
edge_cells.rationale: ch06 strip pixel (700, 150): a loop running along the exit TIR boundary (exit Snell discriminant below event_slowdown_margin) that exhausted the step budget before the rate-based event slowdown

selection.method: the component seeds of seed search at the given target

edge_cells.label: boundary_hugging_r780_c150
edge_cells.name: 3-5__boundary_hugging_r780_c150
edge_cells.rationale: ch06 strip pixel (780, 150): the second boundary-hugging loop of test_boundary_hugging_pixels_fold_every_candidate_into_one_closed_loop

selection.method: the component seeds of seed search at the given target

edge_cells.label: two_arcs_60deg
edge_cells.name: 1-3__two_arcs_60deg
edge_cells.rationale: path 1-3 at delta = 60 deg: two distinct components, each an arc cut by exit TIR at one end and by the entry ray leaving face 1 (path_infeasible) at the other (test_path_1_3_at_60_deg_is_two_distinct_components)

selection.method: the component seeds of seed search at the given target

edge_cells.label: rank_loss_extremum
edge_cells.name: 3-5__rank_loss_extremum
edge_cells.rationale: the seed is the interior minimum of D_P itself, where the fiber degenerates to a point: sigma_2 ~ 1e-16, far below any rank gate, so the trace must end rank_loss with no accepted pose

selection.method: the first interior extremum of D_P itself

edge_cells.label: limits
edge_cells.name: 3-5__limits
edge_cells.rationale: the 3-5 random seed under options that end the trace early: each budget, a corrector that cannot meet maximum_advance, and a step that falls below minimum_step

edge_cells.label: antipodal_target
edge_cells.name: 3-5__antipodal_target
edge_cells.rationale: the 3-5 random pose aimed at the antipode -d of its own outgoing direction: an algebraic zero of the projected residual that the target-neighbourhood gate must reject

selection.target: the antipode -d of the pose's own outgoing direction d

edge_cells.label: boundary_arc_90deg
edge_cells.name: 13-24-26__boundary_arc_90deg
edge_cells.rationale: pyramid 13-24-26 on the reference pyramid at 90 deg: one arc cut by the path domain at both ends, no interior critical point (test_pyramid_boundary_only_path_is_one_arc_up_to_its_boundary_extremum)

selection.method: the component seeds of seed search at the given target
